Merchant ships sighted around here sold a Magicite Cryst for 50,000 gil south of Zoldaad, the High-Power Generator for 60,000 gil in the open ocean south-east of Mysidia, and the Ancient Cloak for 40,000 gil west of Mysidia.

Give the High-Power Generator to Lid for the final radar upgrade: a Magicite Cryst in the open ocean south-east of Mysidia, the Dark Rosary in the ocean straight north of the Crystal Tower, the Evil Eye in the ocean south-west of Pharm, and the Mastery Pendant in the ocean north of the Grandshelt desert.
Swinging by the new Crystal Tower starts the chapter proper, which is worth doing before the optional content.
chests: Magicite Cryst (radar, open ocean south-east of Mysidia)
Dark Rosary (radar, ocean straight north of the Crystal Tower)
Evil Eye (radar, ocean south-west of Pharm)
Mastery Pendant (radar, ocean north of the Grandshelt desert)

8.name: Optional bosses - Sephiroth, Titanoraidos, Malboro Menace
8.summary: Three optional fights, with Sephiroth in Whirlpool Hollow the standout. He is worth a Vision. From here on the order is up to you: the Crystal Tower can be cleared first and a clear save puts you back before the final boss.
steps: Whirlpool Hollow holds Sephiroth. He counters anything you throw at him while Masamune in Waiting is up, goes immune before One Winged Angel, and goes immune again before cutting the party to 1 HP -- after which you have only a few turns before Meteor. Reraise beforehand solves most of that, and Mechamog Scan gives you a weakness to work with.
Titanoraidos Cave: a huge HP pool and Disaster, which Dooms party members.
Malboro Menace Cave: manageable once you recover from the opening Bad Breath and keep him staggered.
bosses: Sephiroth (counters while Masamune in Waiting is up; goes immune before One Winged Angel and before dropping the party to 1 HP; drops Magicite Cryst and Vision: Sephiroth)
Titanoraidos (weak: Ice; Dooms with Disaster; drops Megalixir and Magicite Cryst)
Malboro Menace (weak: Fire; drops Megalixir and Magicite Cryst)

8.name: Dragon's Maw
8.summary: An optional dungeon on the southern tip of Pharm that you cannot flee battles in, and the game's best grinding spot. One Tablet Shard, plus Excalibur and Masamune.
steps: Head forward for Intangir. He casts Meteor if you hit him while he is asleep and again at the end of the fight; his three weaknesses make him easy to keep staggered.
Take the Analysis Hammer and Chef's Knives on the path, then fight the Rogue Magitek Weapon.
Collect the Tablet Shard, Elixirs, Excalibur, the Sniper's Eye, Masamune and a Magicite Cryst.
The island at the end is where that last world-map Megalixir finally becomes reachable.
Gigantaur, Metal Gigantaur and King Gil Snapper all spawn here. This is the place to reach level 99 and master every Vision; Noctis's Barrage makes the Gigantaur fights trivial.
chests: Megalixir (tiny island reached from the end)
bosses: Intangir (weak: Light, Earth and Dark; Meteors if hit while asleep and at the end; drops Elixir)
Rogue Magitek Weapon (weak: Water and Lightning; drops Elixir)
notableSteals: Circlet of Enlightenment from Master Tonberry
Battle Grimoire as a rare drop from Dark Wizard
Azure Amulet as a rare steal from Mizuchi
Bone Mail as a rare steal from Malboro Marquis
Snow Spirit's Scarf as a rare steal from Abhorrent One
Thunder God's Earrings as a rare steal from Ominous One
Vampire Charm as a rare steal from Ganymede
Spellfire as a rare steal from Europa
Rune Shooter from Lost Searcher

8.name: Chamber of Arms
8.summary: Twelve trials that turn each Ancient item into one of the game's best weapons or armour pieces. Every boss can be fought twice: at level 50 to transform the item, and again at level 75 to upgrade it. Almost all of them change weakness or resistance between phases.
steps: The Ancient Katana is the one item not found out in the world -- it is in the final dungeon.
If you levelled on the island at the end of Dragon's Maw, these fights are very manageable.
Interact with each Ancient item to summon its guardian; speak to Chloe after the first one for a scene.
bosses: Dabih (most of the adds are weak to Light; debuffs with Chocobo Nitro and Sacred Wave help)
Nunki (two forms; weakness changes in the first, second is weak to Earth)
Shaula (multiple forms, all weak to Wind)
Brachium (both phases weak to Light; phase one alternates physical and magical evasion, phase two turns to status and death attacks)
Vindeomiatrix (both phases weak to Dark; phase two siphons MP on counter)
Aldhafera (phase one weak to Lightning, phase two weak to Earth and Wind)
Alpherg (reflects on himself and the party immediately; phase one weak to Wind and Ice, phase two changes weakness)
Tegmine (phase one weak to Dark and resists damage until staggered, phase two weak to Earth)
Elnath (both phases weak to Lightning; phase one grows stronger as his stagger bar drops)
Sadalsuud (weakness changes; the second form grows stronger as its wings are defeated)
Sheratan (weak: Fire)
Alhena (weakness changes by phase; phase one immune to magic, phase two immune to physical, and staggering removes it)

8.name: Grandshelt Colosseum - Gladiator League
8.summary: Five battles for the three defensive rings and two Magicite Cryst. Battle five closes with a 100,000-damage Last Breath.
steps: Work through the five battles for their first-win rewards.
Battle five can finish on a Last Breath for around 100,000 damage; Reraise handles it.
Clearing the league grants the Gladiator Proof of Victory, which adds new gear and Magicite Crysts to the shop.

8.name: Crystal Tower
8.summary: The final dungeon, and surprisingly linear. The last three Tablet Shards are here, as is the Ancient Katana for the Chamber of Arms. The last teleport is the point of no return.
steps: Early items: two Tablet Shards, the Pilebunker, and Apocalypse down the northern ramp. Give the Pearly Pot an Elixir.
Take the Chef's Knives, then the portal for an event fight against Dante, who is a regular enemy.
The left staircase leads to Laevateinn and a Megalixir. At the top of the right staircase, keep going up a hidden path to a second Pearly Pot, which also wants an Elixir.
The Ancient Katana is near the save point -- take it before you commit, since the Chamber of Arms trial needs it.
Exit west for a scene, then fight Behemoth. You have to wait for your allies' support attacks before you can damage him.
Third platform: east for the Book of Eibon. Take the next bridge fork west for the last Tablet Shard, then follow the path east for the Hastur Long Barrel.
Take the next bridge north, west, then south for the Dragon Whisker.
After the cutscene on the main path, exit east for another. Near the last save point, take the Faerie Bow and a Magicite Cryst.
The last teleport is the point of no return. A boss weak to Dark comes first, then the spiral and a save point, then the final boss in two parts.
After the credits you can load a clear save, which puts you back in the world before the final boss.

8.name: Post-game - Ultima Weapon and Champion League
8.summary: The hardest content, all of it behind a clear save. Ultima Weapon sits on the south-east island, and the Champion League is the toughest set of battles in the game.
steps: Load a clear save for a cutscene, then fight Ultima Weapon on the south-east island.
Then the Champion League at the Grandshelt Colosseum: Super Ribbon, Lorica Sancta, Lorica Apocalyptica, Dragon Seal and the Omega Badge.
